name: db-down
description: Simulate PostgreSQL temporary outage via docker pause 15s — consumers must pause, no offset loss, drain backlog on recovery

db_down.command: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose/docker-compose.yml pause postgres && sleep 15 && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose/docker-compose.yml unpause postgres
db_down.alt_command: docker pause transaction-engine-kafka-postgres-1 && sleep 15 && docker unpause transaction-engine-kafka-postgres-1

verify: powershell -File scripts/Invoke-Project.ps1 -Command verify-invariants; curl -s http://localhost:8082/actuator/health/readiness | jq .; curl -s http://localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=up | jq .
